master_equation.multi_n: mu_A=-RT ln(p0_soft)-RT ln sum_n exp[-beta A_n]
master_equation.active_support_runtime: mu_A=-RT ln(p0_soft)-RT ln sum_{n=0}^{nmax} exp[-beta A_n]+RT ln[1-x_tail]
master_equation.periodic_bridge_gate: A_n versus g_n-RT ln[p_tilde(n)/p0_soft] for every active n

term_roles.p0_soft: one additive packing term through -RT ln(p0_soft)
term_roles.x_tilde_n: fixed-n and direct-n0 cross-check; not an additional multi-n term
term_roles.p_tilde_n_nonzero: Hamiltonian-bridge reference and falsifier; not added on top of the cluster density-volume ledger
term_roles.A_n: one conditioned row containing association, density-volume, labeled-to-unlabeled symmetry and outer reference exactly once
term_roles.packing_evidence: mandatory factory-validated SoftPackingEstimate plus reference occupancy bridge; arbitrary mappings and arbitrary p0 values are rejected

exact_vs_approximate.periodic_soft_qct_identity: exact for the declared finite or periodic Hamiltonians and omega_n
exact_vs_approximate.cluster_periodic_difference_role: preregistered embedding residual and falsification gate; never labeled exact closure
exact_vs_approximate.boundary_bridge_definition: one boundary-independent membership surface plus distinct symmetric periodic-image and nonperiodic cluster adapters
exact_vs_approximate.exact_occupancy_provenance: finite-state-oracle artifacts only; public empirical estimators cannot claim exact finite enumeration by changing an estimator label
exact_vs_approximate.exact_conditional_coupling_provenance: finite-state-oracle artifacts only and source hash must match the exact reference and coupled distributions
exact_vs_approximate.finite_periodic_boundary_adapter: canonical identity derived from membership definition, observation volume, solute measure, periodic boundary conditions and the finite coordinate-adapter declaration

covariance.shared_bootstrap_evidence: replicate-level QCTBootstrapEvidence artifact required; a naked evidence hash is rejected
covariance.shared_bootstrap_column_order: canonical labeled ledger order [p_active,p_tail,x_active,x_tail,A_active,g_active] is required
covariance.shared_bootstrap_source_binding: one source artifact hash binds the reference distribution, coupled distribution, conditioned profile and conditional-coupling profile
covariance.nonzero_cross_block_propagation: nonzero shared-bootstrap cross-block covariance must be retained and must alter propagated ledger uncertainty relative to the block-diagonal counterfactual
covariance.exact_enumeration_relation: zero covariance plus one matching finite-oracle source artifact

finite_enumeration.primitive_partition_factors: coupling Boltzmann factors, rho*Veff, release factors, outer factors, then divide by n! exactly once
